# Libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(fitdistrplus)
library(patchwork)
```

# Data Extraction

Data for RRFs are coming from the US FDA CLAP List. <https://cdrh-rst.fda.gov/chemicals-list-analytical-performance-clap>

Each file is in PDF format and contains RRF values at three surrogate concentrations: `LCMS RRFs CLAP Negative Ion Detection.pdf`, `LCMS RRFs CLAP Positive Ion Detection.pdf`, `RRF GCMS for CLAP.pdf`.

**Censoring convention (Turnbull NPMLE):** Values that are exactly 0 or at/below the LOQ (0.001) are treated as *left-censored* at the LOQ rather than discarded.

```{r}
# GC/MS — keep ALL rows; column-level NAs handled by censoring below
gcms_clap   <- read_excel(path = "processed_data/GCMS.xlsx",  sheet = "GC-MS")

# LC/MS POS — keep ALL rows
lcmspos_clap <- read_excel(path = "processed_data/LCMS.xlsx", sheet = "LCMSPOS")

# LC/MS NEG — keep ALL rows
lcmsneg_clap <- read_excel(path = "processed_data/LCMS.xlsx", sheet = "LCMSNEG")

loq <- 0.001          # limit of quantification used as right-bound for censored obs.
gamma_params <- data.frame()

# Helper: build the two-column censored data frame for fitdistcens
# Detected (v > loq)  → left = right = v        (exact observation)
# N.D. / BDL / NA    → left = NA, right = loq   (left-censored)
make_cens <- function(v) {
  v <- as.numeric(v)
  data.frame(
    left  = ifelse(is.na(v) | v <= loq, NA,  v),
    right = ifelse(is.na(v) | v <= loq, loq, v)
  )
}
```

# Exploratory Distributions

```{r}
gcms_long <- gcms_clap %>%
  dplyr::select(`5 µg/mL`, `10 µg/mL`, `20 µg/mL`) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "Concentration", values_to = "RRF") %>%
  mutate(Concentration = factor(Concentration, levels = c("5 µg/mL", "10 µg/mL", "20 µg/mL")))

ggplot(gcms_long, aes(x = RRF, fill = Concentration)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, color = "black", alpha = 0.75) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("5 µg/mL" = "skyblue", "10 µg/mL" = "orange", "20 µg/mL" = "indianred")) +
  facet_wrap(~ Concentration, ncol = 3) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.position = "none", panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")) +
  labs(title = "Distribution of GC/MS Relative Response Factors",
       subtitle = "Surrogate concentrations: 5, 10, and 20 µg/mL", x = "RRF", y = "Frequency")
```

# GC/MS Analysis

## 5 µg/mL

```{r}
cens_data <- make_cens(gcms_clap$"5 µg/mL")

set.seed(123)
fnorm  <- fitdistcens(cens_data, "norm")
flnorm <- fitdistcens(cens_data, "lnorm")
fgamma <- fitdistcens(cens_data, "gamma")

summary(fnorm); summary(flnorm); summary(fgamma)

gamma_params <- rbind(gamma_params, data.frame(
  Technique = "GC/MS", Concentration = "5 µg/mL",
  shape = fgamma$estimate["shape"], rate = fgamma$estimate["rate"]
))

RRF_df <- data.frame(RRF = cens_data$right)
p_fit <- ggplot(RRF_df, aes(x = RRF)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density)), bins = 20,
                 fill = "lightgray", color = "white", na.rm = TRUE) +
  stat_function(fun = dnorm,   args = list(mean  = fnorm$estimate["mean"],    sd    = fnorm$estimate["sd"]),       aes(color = "Normal"),     linewidth = 1) +
  stat_function(fun = dlnorm,  args = list(meanlog = flnorm$estimate["meanlog"], sdlog = flnorm$estimate["sdlog"]), aes(color = "Log-normal"), linewidth = 1) +
  stat_function(fun = dgamma,  args = list(shape = fgamma$estimate["shape"],  rate  = fgamma$estimate["rate"]),   aes(color = "Gamma"),      linewidth = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Distribution",
                     values = c("Normal" = "darkblue", "Log-normal" = "darkred", "Gamma" = "darkgreen")) +
  labs(title = "GC/MS 5 µg/mL: Fit Comparison", x = "RRF", y = "Density") +
  theme_minimal()

qq_norm  <- ggplot(RRF_df, aes(sample = RRF)) +
  stat_qq(distribution = qnorm,  dparams = list(mean = fnorm$estimate["mean"], sd = fnorm$estimate["sd"]), alpha = 0.5) +
  stat_qq_line(distribution = qnorm, dparams = list(mean = fnorm$estimate["mean"], sd = fnorm$estimate["sd"]), color = "darkblue", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(title = "Normal Q-Q",
       x = "Theoretical quantiles (RRF)",
       y = "Sample quantiles (RRF)") + theme_minimal(base_size = 13)

qq_lnorm <- ggplot(RRF_df, aes(sample = RRF)) +
  stat_qq(distribution = qlnorm, dparams = list(meanlog = flnorm$estimate["meanlog"], sdlog = flnorm$estimate["sdlog"]), alpha = 0.5) +
  stat_qq_line(distribution = qlnorm, dparams = list(meanlog = flnorm$estimate["meanlog"], sdlog = flnorm$estimate["sdlog"]), color = "darkred", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(title = "Log-normal Q-Q",
       x = "Theoretical quantiles (RRF)",
       y = "Sample quantiles (RRF)") + theme_minimal(base_size = 13)

qq_gamma <- ggplot(RRF_df, aes(sample = RRF)) +
  stat_qq(distribution = qgamma, dparams = list(shape = fgamma$estimate["shape"], rate = fgamma$estimate["rate"]), alpha = 0.5) +
  stat_qq_line(distribution = qgamma, dparams = list(shape = fgamma$estimate["shape"], rate = fgamma$estimate["rate"]), color = "darkgreen", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(title = "Gamma Q-Q",
       x = "Theoretical quantiles (RRF)",
       y = "Sample quantiles (RRF)") + theme_minimal(base_size = 13)

(qq_norm + qq_lnorm + qq_gamma)
```

## Overlaid Distribution — GC/MS (empirical only, no fitted curve)

```{r}
# ── Raw data reshaped for all three concentrations ────────────────────────────
raw_long_gcms_clap <- bind_rows(
  data.frame(Concentration = "5 µg/mL",  RRF = as.numeric(gcms_clap$"5 µg/mL")),
  data.frame(Concentration = "10 µg/mL", RRF = as.numeric(gcms_clap$"10 µg/mL")),
  data.frame(Concentration = "20 µg/mL", RRF = as.numeric(gcms_clap$"20 µg/mL"))
) %>%
  filter(!is.na(RRF), RRF > loq) %>%
  mutate(Concentration = factor(Concentration, levels = c("5 µg/mL", "10 µg/mL", "20 µg/mL")))

# ── Plot: histogram only (no fitted curve — direct sampling used in simulation) ──
ggplot(raw_long_gcms_clap, aes(x = RRF)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density), fill = Concentration),
                 position = "identity", bins = 50, color = "black", alpha = 0.45) +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "Concentration",
                    values = c("5 µg/mL" = "skyblue", "10 µg/mL" = "orange", "20 µg/mL" = "indianred")) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.position = "top", legend.box = "vertical",
        legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")) +
  labs(title = "RRF Distribution — GC/MS (empirical, direct sampling)",
       x = "RRF", y = "Density")
```

## Overlaid Distribution — LC/MS NEG (gamma fit only)


```{r}
# ── Raw data reshaped for all three concentrations ────────────────────────────
raw_long_lcmsneg_clap <- bind_rows(
  data.frame(Concentration = "5 µg/mL",  RRF = as.numeric(lcmsneg_clap$"5 µg/mL")),
  data.frame(Concentration = "10 µg/mL", RRF = as.numeric(lcmsneg_clap$"10 µg/mL")),
  data.frame(Concentration = "20 µg/mL", RRF = as.numeric(lcmsneg_clap$"20 µg/mL"))
) %>%
  filter(!is.na(RRF), RRF > loq) %>%
  mutate(Concentration = factor(Concentration, levels = c("5 µg/mL", "10 µg/mL", "20 µg/mL")))

# ── Gamma curves from fitted parameters ───────────────────────────────────────
x_seq  <- seq(0.001, max(raw_long_lcmsneg_clap$RRF, na.rm = TRUE), length.out = 500)
gp_sub <- gamma_params %>% filter(Technique == "LC/MS NEG")

gamma_curves_lcmsneg_clap <- gp_sub %>%
  group_by(Concentration) %>%
  reframe(
    RRF     = x_seq,
    Density = dgamma(x_seq, shape = shape[1], rate = rate[1])
  ) %>%
  mutate(Concentration = factor(Concentration, levels = c("5 µg/mL", "10 µg/mL", "20 µg/mL")))

# ── Plot: histogram + gamma fit only (LogNormal reference removed) ────────────
ggplot(raw_long_lcmsneg_clap, aes(x = RRF)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density), fill = Concentration),
                 position = "identity", bins = 50, color = "black", alpha = 0.45) +
  geom_line(data = gamma_curves_lcmsneg_clap,
            aes(x = RRF, y = Density, group = Concentration, color = Concentration),
            linewidth = 1.1) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 1.25), ylim = c(0, 15)) +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "Concentration",
                    values = c("5 µg/mL" = "skyblue", "10 µg/mL" = "orange", "20 µg/mL" = "indianred")) +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Concentration (gamma fit)",
                     values = c("5 µg/mL" = "steelblue4", "10 µg/mL" = "darkorange3", "20 µg/mL" = "firebrick4")) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.position = "top", legend.box = "vertical",
        legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")) +
  labs(title = "RRF distribution — LC/MS NEG (gamma fit)",
       x = "RRF", y = "Density")
```

## 5 µg/mL

```{r}
cens_data <- make_cens(lcmspos_clap$"5 µg/mL")

set.seed(123)
fnorm  <- fitdistcens(cens_data, "norm")
flnorm <- fitdistcens(cens_data, "lnorm")
fgamma <- fitdistcens(cens_data, "gamma")

summary(fnorm); summary(flnorm); summary(fgamma)

gamma_params <- rbind(gamma_params, data.frame(
  Technique = "LC/MS POS", Concentration = "5 µg/mL",
  shape = fgamma$estimate["shape"], rate = fgamma$estimate["rate"]
))

RRF_df <- data.frame(RRF = cens_data$right)
p_fit <- ggplot(RRF_df, aes(x = RRF)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density)), bins = 20, fill = "lightgray", color = "white", na.rm = TRUE) +
  stat_function(fun = dnorm,  args = list(mean    = fnorm$estimate["mean"],    sd    = fnorm$estimate["sd"]),       aes(color = "Normal"),     linewidth = 1) +
  stat_function(fun = dlnorm, args = list(meanlog = flnorm$estimate["meanlog"], sdlog = flnorm$estimate["sdlog"]), aes(color = "Log-normal"), linewidth = 1) +
  stat_function(fun = dgamma, args = list(shape   = fgamma$estimate["shape"],  rate  = fgamma$estimate["rate"]),   aes(color = "Gamma"),      linewidth = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Distribution",
                     values = c("Normal" = "darkblue", "Log-normal" = "darkred", "Gamma" = "darkgreen")) +
  labs(title = "LC/MS POS 5 µg/mL: Fit Comparison", x = "RRF", y = "Density") + theme_minimal()

qq_norm  <- ggplot(RRF_df, aes(sample = RRF)) +
  stat_qq(distribution = qnorm,  dparams = list(mean = fnorm$estimate["mean"], sd = fnorm$estimate["sd"]), alpha = 0.5) +
  stat_qq_line(distribution = qnorm, dparams = list(mean = fnorm$estimate["mean"], sd = fnorm$estimate["sd"]), color = "darkblue", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(title = "Normal Q-Q",
       x = "Theoretical quantiles (RRF)",
       y = "Sample quantiles (RRF)") + theme_minimal(base_size = 13)

qq_lnorm <- ggplot(RRF_df, aes(sample = RRF)) +
  stat_qq(distribution = qlnorm, dparams = list(meanlog = flnorm$estimate["meanlog"], sdlog = flnorm$estimate["sdlog"]), alpha = 0.5) +
  stat_qq_line(distribution = qlnorm, dparams = list(meanlog = flnorm$estimate["meanlog"], sdlog = flnorm$estimate["sdlog"]), color = "darkred", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(title = "Log-normal Q-Q",
       x = "Theoretical quantiles (RRF)",
       y = "Sample quantiles (RRF)") + theme_minimal(base_size = 13)

qq_gamma <- ggplot(RRF_df, aes(sample = RRF)) +
  stat_qq(distribution = qgamma, dparams = list(shape = fgamma$estimate["shape"], rate = fgamma$estimate["rate"]), alpha = 0.5) +
  stat_qq_line(distribution = qgamma, dparams = list(shape = fgamma$estimate["shape"], rate = fgamma$estimate["rate"]), color = "darkgreen", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(title = "Gamma Q-Q",
       x = "Theoretical quantiles (RRF)",
       y = "Sample quantiles (RRF)") + theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
```
